name: Greek Salad
steps: Wash and dry the 4 cups chopped romaine and place in a large salad bowl.
Add the 2/3 cup chopped walnuts, 1/3 cup sliced strawberries, 1 cup sliced strawberries.
In a small jar, shake together the 1/2 tablespoon olive oil, 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, and 1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt until emulsified.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is lightly coated. Serve right away.
